articles.title: Ayyappa Mala, Second Marriage Dispute Ends in Murder? Woman’s Body Found in River in Hassan
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case has been reported from Yadur village in Alur taluk of Hassan district, where a man allegedly killed his first wife for questioning his second marriage and dumped her body in a river.

body.html:
A shocking murder case has been reported from Yadur village in Alur taluk of Hassan district, where a man allegedly killed his first wife for questioning his second marriage and dumped her body in a river.

The victim, Radha (40), had been living separately from her husband Kumar for the past four years. The incident reportedly took place on the night of January 10.

According to the complaint, Kumar had observed the Ayyappa vow in the first week of January and was wearing the sacred mala. While preparations were underway to tie the irumudi for his Sabarimala pilgrimage, Radha noticed that another woman had performed the ritual worship reserved for the wife. She allegedly came to Yadur on January 10 to question this.

An argument reportedly broke out, following which Kumar and his family members allegedly murdered Radha, as claimed by her family.

On Monday, Kumar allegedly confessed to the police that he had killed Radha and thrown her body into the Yagachi River near Kandali in Hassan taluk. Police conducted a search on Tuesday and recovered the body.

A case has been registered at Alur Police Station. The accused has been arrested and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Learner Driver Horror in Jodhpur: Woman Crushed to Death Outside Shop, CCTV Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has emerged from Jodhpur in Rajasthan, where a woman was run over by a car allegedly being driven by a learner, leading to her death. The incident, captured on CCTV, has triggered outrage after the disturbing footage surfaced on social media.

body.html:
A shocking incident has emerged from Jodhpur in Rajasthan, where a woman was run over by a car allegedly being driven by a learner, leading to her death. The incident, captured on CCTV, has triggered outrage after the disturbing footage surfaced on social media.

According to reports, the car occupants were practising driving when the mishap occurred. The vehicle was reportedly being driven by a man or his maternal uncle. The deceased has been identified as Bhanvari Devi.

Police sources said the woman was standing outside a general store when a white-coloured car lost control, first hit a parked motorcycle and then ran over her, crushing her to death on the spot.

In the viral CCTV footage, locals are seen rushing to rescue the victim immediately after the incident. One of the occupants also stepped out of the car following the crash. However, the exact identity of the driver remains unclear.

The incident took place on January 10 at Street Number 6 in Veer Durgadas Colony. Both occupants of the car were reportedly arrested in connection with the case.

So far, the Jodhpur Police have not issued any official statement. Details regarding the sections under which the accused have been booked are yet to be disclosed.

articles.title: Illicit Affair Exposed: Bengaluru Techie Arrested After Wife’s Complaint, Caught with Lover in PG
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Bengaluru Police have arrested a techie, Jedrela Jacob Aroop, on charges of cheating, caste-based abuse, assault and mental harassment of his wife. The arrest was made by the DCRE West Division police following a complaint filed by the victim.

body.html:
The Bengaluru Police have arrested a techie, Jedrela Jacob Aroop, on charges of cheating, caste-based abuse, assault and mental harassment of his wife. The arrest was made by the DCRE West Division police following a complaint filed by the victim.

According to the police, Jacob had been living with his wife in Bengaluru for the past two years. His wife was employed in a reputed private company and earned a salary running into several lakhs of rupees. As Jacob was unemployed, it is alleged that she quit her job and supported him in securing employment.

After the birth of their child, Jacob allegedly subjected his wife to caste-based abuse and physical and mental harassment. The complaint further states that he assaulted her in a manner that could have caused a miscarriage.

Police investigations revealed that, without his wife’s knowledge, Jacob had developed a live-in relationship with another young woman and was actively making social media reels with her.

Acting on the information provided by the complainant, the police raided a PG accommodation in Electronic City, where Jacob was allegedly caught red-handed with his lover.

A case has been registered at the Bengaluru DCRE West Division Police Station, and the accused is currently undergoing intensive interrogation.

articles.title: Miracle or Mere Coincidence? Temple Video from UP Sparks Heated Debate on Faith vs Science
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video from Nandpur village in Bijnor district, Uttar Pradesh, near the Nagina area, is going viral on social media platform X. The footage shows a dog continuously circling the idol of Bajrangbali at a Hanuman temple for three days, according to local residents.

body.html:
A video from Nandpur village in Bijnor district, Uttar Pradesh, near the Nagina area, is going viral on social media platform X. The footage shows a dog continuously circling the idol of Bajrangbali at a Hanuman temple for three days, according to local residents.

The video caption claims that after roaming the temple premises day and night, the dog sat down briefly, when a pigeon landed on it and reportedly died within moments. Those present were left shocked, with the incident described by some as a “divine play”.

As the video spread online, reactions poured in. Many users called it a miracle of Bajrangbali and linked the dog’s behaviour to devotion, while others dismissed it as a coincidence and a natural phenomenon. Some comments described the incident as emotionally moving, while sceptical voices urged people to apply scientific and logical reasoning before calling it a miracle.

The video has since triggered a wider debate on social media over faith, belief and rational explanation.

articles.excerpt: The suspicious death of 26-year-old software engineer Aiman Khan in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, has sent shockwaves through Lucknow. What was thought to be a successful love marriage has turned into a harrowing tale of alleged dowry harassment, torture, and murder.

body.html:
The suspicious death of 26-year-old software engineer Aiman Khan in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, has sent shockwaves through Lucknow. What was thought to be a successful love marriage has turned into a harrowing tale of alleged dowry harassment, torture, and murder.

In this video, we break down the timeline of events—from Aiman’s marriage to Aamir Khan in April 2025 to the tragic return of her body to Lucknow on January 13, 2026.

Key Highlights of the Case:
The Allegations: Aiman’s father, Sher Ali, alleges she was murdered by her husband and in-laws for a ₹20 lakh dowry and a car.

Physical Abuse: Upon the arrival of her body, family members reported visible injuries, including belt marks and wounds, suggesting prolonged torture.

The Saudi Connection: Aiman moved to Jeddah in June 2025. Her family claims her passport was confiscated and she was denied basic necessities.

Legal Action: An FIR under IPC Section 304B (Dowry Death) has been registered at the Chinhat police station in Lucknow.

Timeline of Events:
April 10, 2025: Aiman and Aamir marry in Lucknow.
June 2025: Aiman joins Aamir in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
October 2025: Aiman returns to India briefly, alleging torture.
December 18, 2025: Aiman dies under suspicious circumstances in Jeddah.
January 13, 2026: Her body reaches Lucknow; visible injuries lead to a police complaint.

articles.title: Protected First, Assaulted Later: Home Guard Attacked on Bengaluru Road After Advising Woman
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident was reported from KR Puram in Bengaluru on Friday evening, where a woman home guard was allegedly assaulted by a young woman following a brief roadside argument.

body.html:
A disturbing incident was reported from KR Puram in Bengaluru on Friday evening, where a woman home guard was allegedly assaulted by a young woman following a brief roadside argument. The incident has once again raised concerns over public safety and attacks on uniformed personnel performing their duties.

According to police, the incident occurred when a young woman was walking along the road wearing revealing clothes. Some men allegedly passed inappropriate looks at her. At that moment, home guard personnel Lakshmi Narasamma, an elderly woman deployed nearby, intervened and protected the young woman from the men.

After ensuring her safety, Lakshmi Narasamma reportedly advised the woman in a calm manner. She cautioned her that the area often witnesses misbehaviour by men and suggested she be cautious for her own safety, explaining that miscreants often target women walking alone.

The advice reportedly angered the young woman, identified as Damini alias Mohini. Eyewitnesses stated that she suddenly grabbed Lakshmi Narasamma by her hair, dragged her and assaulted her, causing injuries to her face and nose. The home guard reportedly started bleeding due to the attack.

People present at the spot intervened immediately, separated the two and rescued Lakshmi Narasamma. She later approached the police and filed a formal complaint against the accused.

Police reached the spot, arrested Damini alias Mohini and produced her before a court. The court subsequently remanded her to judicial custody and sent her to Parappana Agrahara Central Jail in Bengaluru.

Further details revealed that the accused had studied in a school in the Maldives and later completed her BBM degree in Bengaluru. Police noted that despite her educational background, she showed no respect towards an elderly uniformed official.

Officials stated that even if the woman disagreed with the advice, she could have expressed her disagreement politely, including asserting that her clothing was a personal choice. However, resorting to physical violence against a home guard on duty led to her arrest and imprisonment.

articles.title: Bengaluru: 18-Year-Old Neighbor Arrested in Ramamurthy Nagar Techie Case
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: What initially looked like a tragic fire accident in Bengaluru’s Ramamurthy Nagar has turned into a major criminal investigation. On January 3rd, 34-year-old software engineer was found deceased in her apartment.

body.html:
What initially looked like a tragic fire accident in Bengaluru’s Ramamurthy Nagar has turned into a major criminal investigation. On January 3rd, 34-year-old software engineer was found deceased in her apartment. While early reports suggested accidental suffocation, police were baffled by several inconsistencies: an open window, no source of ignition, and a missing mobile phone.

In this video, we cover how the Ramamurthy Nagar police and Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) team pieced together the digital and physical evidence to uncover the truth. The investigation led to the arrest of an 18-year-old student living next door, revealing a disturbing sequence of events involving a break-in and a fatal assault.

Key Updates Covered:
The Incident: Why the "fire accident" theory was ruled out.
The Evidence: How the missing phone and an open window became key leads.
The Arrest: Police apprehend the 18-year-old suspect, identified as Kurai.
The Charges: Details on the legal sections filed (Sections 103, 64(2), 67, and 238).
